Regime witness reconciliation (D-0078 amendment evidence). The
witness is the safe arm's recorded per-trial `page_verify`
delta, read from each campaign's **pinned** CSVs; the canary
columns appear where the pinned `runs.csv` carries them.
Witness absolutes compare only **within one kernel family**
(the safe arm's `kernel_sha256`), so rows are grouped by
family; the regime divide is applied only inside a family
that exhibits both clusters or a corroborating in-family boot
record. Warmup `page_verify` is joined by batch and trial
position; the closing finding is computed from that join.
Regeneration: `python3 scripts/regime-witness.py`.

Canary vs recorded witness: 2 disagreements (t47b, t47c). The recorded witness is the campaign's regime; a disagreement is the canary failing as a certificate, not a mid-run flip unless the warmup-position join says so.

Join by (batch, position) — not campaign-flat warmup order — refutes a first-two-warmups flip: t47b: canary 12.070 ms (deflated) vs batch-1 position-1 16.28 ms (inflated); the deflated warmup is batch-2 position-1 11.85 ms, not the first trial-conditions boot.

Structural cluster, derived from disagreeing canaries and every batch-boundary first safe warmup that dips ≥ 1 ms below its campaign's other warmups: [11.78, 12.11] ms (8 boots). Every batch-2 position-1 safe warmup of an inflated recorded campaign falls in that cluster. Lone e0drift witness boots are not in these pins and are not asserted here.

The same position dips on the m-lane (no OpenSBI, no DBCN): t47b batch-2 position-1 7.18 ms vs sibling median 10.80 ms; t47c batch-2 position-1 7.18 ms vs sibling median 10.90 ms — lane-independent, host-side of the polled UART.

Idle gap before the spawn (e0_mono − previous trial's e0+E4, same batch): dipped boots 0.68–0.72 s, inflated neighbors 0.68–0.72 s — ranges overlap, so wall-clock spacing is not the driver.
